selectedFunctions.label: Stake caller-funded LPT into validator delegation
warnings: Pulls LPT from caller under existing allowance, rebases and stakes through current registry-selected adapter; receiver receives rebasing tTokens. Amount is 18-decimal LPT, not shares; native value must be zero.

Rebase includes rewards/slashing and a registry fee capped in this implementation at 0.5% of rewards. Fixed financial adapter delegatecalls are not caller-programmable; registry changes and Livepeer remain dependencies.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Request owned LPT delegation withdrawal
warnings: Burns caller tToken assets after rebase and opens Livepeer unbonding lock plus caller-owned Unlocks NFT. Amount uses 18-decimal asset units, not internal shares.
Exit is queued in Livepeer rounds, not instant. Ownership and unstaking liquidity/maturity must be established independently.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Claim matured owned LPT withdrawal
warnings: Unlocks.useUnlock requires the caller to own the exact NFT for this tenderizer/unlockID; merely being an NFT-approved operator is insufficient. NFT is burned and actual withdrawn LPT sent to receiver.
Livepeer enforces maturity and returns actual withdrawable assets; recipient selection does not bypass claim ownership. No arbitrary callback or executable calldata input.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.
